description: This file provides utility functions for handling local file access, including validation of file URLs, path normalization, and extraction of basename from media sources. It accommodates platform-specific behaviors (Windows) and ensures safety against remote or invalid file URLs.

methods.description: Throws an error if the provided file path is a Windows network path, used for validation.

methods.name: export function trySafeFileURLToPath(fileUrl: string): string | undefined { trySafeFileURLToPath
